about: GitHub's answers to the two requests of renderings that read four planted texts of the archived public test repository Dennis-Otto/reading-measurements by their numbers on 2026-11-23, with gh and the maintainer's token: the cursors of the comments of issue 6, then issue 1, issue 35 (which doesn't exist), the answer of discussion 38 (which has none) and the second and fourth comment of issue 6, each a window of one after the cursor of the comment before it. Every text of the repository is the maintainer's own, planted for the measurement of #521.

exchanges.query: query($owner: String!, $name: String!, $number: Int!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { issue(number: $number) { comments(first: 100, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } edges { cursor node { fullDatabaseId } } } } } rateLimit { cost remaining } }

query($owner: String!, $name: String!, $w0: String!, $w1: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { i1: issue(number: 1) { body bodyHTML } i35: issue(number: 35) { body bodyHTML } a38: discussion(number: 38) { answer { body bodyHTML } } c6: issue(number: 6) { w0: comments(first: 1, after: $w0) { nodes { fullDatabaseId body bodyHTML } } w1: comments(first: 1, after: $w1) { nodes { fullDatabaseId body bodyHTML } } } } rateLimit { cost remaining } }
